scoring: exhaustive CPU torch.mm float32 inner product on saved unit-normalized vectors; no ANN, quantization, score threshold or candidate filtering
ranking: descending computed float32 score, then ascending product_id, including all cutoff ties; no approximate tie tolerance
encoding: unchanged pinned E5 encoder/settings; NFKC and query: prefix, max_length 128, batch size 32, float32; MPS if available otherwise explicit CPU
corpus: verified catalog-embeddings-v1; each query searches every product in its own locale
metrics: same known-Exact Recall@100 and actual-returned judgment coverage@10 definitions as catalog-bm25-title-v1; unknown relevance stays unknown; coverage is not precision
comparison: paired percentile bootstrap over identical locale-normalized query groups; dense minus BM25; query-weighted overall and per locale, secondary equal-locale means
hypothesis: dense retrieval may recover vocabulary gaps but may regress lexical matches; no minimum gain or adoption threshold is assumed
repeat: two fresh runs must agree on query inputs/vectors, ranked results, per-query metrics and confidence intervals; resource timings may differ
scope: fixed validation-development reference; no hyperparameter/model tuning, fusion, ANN, training, LLM judgments, API or official test access
